facts.site: Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility

response.justification: MOC-2005-0139 was raised at Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility on 2 November 2005 following 1 recorded event in the archive, including NM-2011-0012. The engineering change note record covers 3 clauses across 5 controlled documents. The intent is to replace an existing requirement with one written to the current house style. The record reached the state abandoned in the change stream.
response.risk_note: No control is relaxed by this change; the residual risk position is unchanged or improved, and the key safeguard set is preserved.
response.scope_note: The documents in scope are MOC-2019-0221, PRO-MEC-021, PTW-STD-002, STD-ISO-006 and STD-PTW-001.
